title: BenCoDiC: A Large-Scale Contextual Cyberbullying Corpus for Bengali Political News Discourse FULL VERSION
abstract: arXiv:2610.13121v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Cyberbullying is a growing concern in online communities, yet existing Bengali corpora remain limited in contextual information, annotation transparency, scale, accessibility, and support for multidimensional analysis, thereby hindering robust detection and comprehensive study of harasser behaviors and networks. To address these gaps, we introduce the Bengali Contextual and Diverse Cyberbullying (\textit{BenCoDiC}) corpus, a publicly available contextual cyberbullying resource for Bengali political news discourse comprising 50,250 textual instances collected from 100 YouTube videos and their associated discussions. The corpus preserves caption--comment--reply relationships and is organized through a nine-dimensional star schema covering users, videos, textual content, context, time, engagement, political parties, target identities, and language categories. translated_title: BenCoDiC：面向孟加拉语政治新闻话语的大规模语境化网络欺凌语料库（完整版）
translated_abstract: 网络欺凌是在线社区中日益受到关注的问题，然而现有的孟加拉语语料库在语境信息、标注透明度、规模、可访问性以及对多维分析的支持方面仍然有限，从而阻碍了对欺凌者行为和网络进行稳健检测与全面研究。为了弥补这些不足，我们提出了孟加拉语语境化与多样化网络欺凌语料库，这是一个公开可用的面向孟加拉语政治新闻话语的语境化网络欺凌资源，包含从100个YouTube视频及其相关讨论中收集的50,250条文本实例。该语料库保留了标题—评论—回复之间的关系，并通过九维星型模式进行组织，涵盖用户、视频、文本内容、语境、时间、互动参与度、政党、目标身份和语言类别等维度。研究最初评估了五个AI聊天机器人用于标注，但其未能达到预设的要求（原文摘要在此处被截断）。
tldr: 该论文构建并公开了首个大规模、语境化、多维度的孟加拉语政治新闻网络欺凌语料库BenCoDiC，包含50,250条保留评论回复结构的文本实例，通过九维星型模式组织数据，为网络欺凌检测与欺凌者行为网络研究提供有力支持。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces BenCoDiC, a publicly available large-scale contextual cyberbullying corpus of 50,250 Bengali political news discourse instances with preserved caption-comment-reply structures, organized through a nine-dimensional star schema to enable robust detection and multidimensional analysis of harasser behaviors and networks.
